items.t: Centene (CNC) Down 3.5% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
items.sum: Centene (CNC) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.t: $100 Invested In Centene 20 Years Ago Would Be Worth This Much Today
items.sum: Centene (NYSE:CNC) has outperformed the market over the past 20 years by 3.63% on an annualized basis producing an average annual return of 12.15%. Currently, Centene has a market capitalization of $31.35 billion.

items.t: Centene: Top Stock To Watch For 2027 From My 'Dean's List'
items.sum: Analyst rates Centene Corporation a Buy at ~11.5x 2027 consensus EPS, citing 2026 guidance above $5.20 and rate resets on just over 40% of Medicaid revenue in 2027.

items.t: Just a handful of payers control US health insurance markets, AMA warns
items.sum: New data from the physician lobby finds 95% of metro health insurance markets are still highly concentrated, fueling calls for regulatory scrutiny.
